scientific_scope: finite point comparison of two response-equivalent parity-3 realizations on one CPython 3.12 hosted-Linux execution substrate; not a universal intelligence-family claim

problem.obligation: For every x in {0,1}^3, emit x0 XOR x1 XOR x2 exactly.

family_definitions.NEURAL: A feed-forward affine-threshold network with four hidden threshold units, one for each positive parity minterm, followed by one threshold output unit.
family_definitions.NON_NEURAL: A direct deterministic Boolean program composing two XOR operations; no affine-threshold hidden-unit realization is used by the candidate.

candidates.reachability: directly constructed frozen source; no training/search
directly constructed frozen source; no training/search

development_accounting.development_reachability_gate: both candidate functions must be present and pass exhaustive capability before measurement
development_accounting.reason: This first point experiment tests the deployment realization-selection bridge only. It does not compare learning algorithms or authoring cost.

measurement_schedule.candidate_order: alternate N->X and X->N by block index

registered_resource_coordinates.name: python_opcode_count_per_full_domain_sweep
registered_resource_coordinates.semantics: exact CPython opcode events executed inside the candidate function over the 8 protected inputs
registered_resource_coordinates.uncertainty: none for the executed interpreter/code artifact

registered_resource_coordinates.name: wall_block_ns
registered_resource_coordinates.semantics: perf_counter_ns elapsed time for exactly 160000 protected candidate calls in one timed block
registered_resource_coordinates.uncertainty: finite observed schedule envelope [minimum block, maximum block]; no claim of population confidence beyond the registered run

registered_resource_coordinates.name: process_block_ns
registered_resource_coordinates.semantics: process_time_ns CPU time for exactly 160000 protected candidate calls in one timed block
registered_resource_coordinates.uncertainty: finite observed schedule envelope [minimum block, maximum block]; no claim of population confidence beyond the registered run

selection_rule.rule: A family is selected only if its candidate's upper bound is <= the competitor's lower bound in every registered resource coordinate and strictly lower in at least one. Otherwise abstain.

prospective_prediction.prediction: X_XOR2_V1 will robustly dominate N_THRESHOLD_DNF4_V1 in the registered three-coordinate resource box on the CPython 3.12 hosted-runner scope.
prospective_prediction.falsifier: Any capability failure invalidates the packet. If the registered resource boxes fail robust non-neural domination, the prediction fails and the terminal must be UNDECIDED unless neural robust domination is observed.
prospective_prediction.post_failure_rule: Do not change candidates, resources, repetitions, tie-breaking, or scope in this version after seeing results.

planned_attack_candidates: an independently optimized exact neural threshold implementation

claim_ceiling: A successful result is a point verdict about these frozen candidates and this registered hosted-runner/CPython scope. It is not evidence that non-neural intelligence is universally preferable, nor that parity-3 is representative of general intelligence.
